name: roundaible-web
description: AI-Powered Multi-Agent Code Generation and Collaborative Reasoning (local-first web app)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend

author: Navid Moradimehr
